LESSON: HOMEMADE SUN DRYER

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.2: Homemade Sun Dryer

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Homemade Sun Dryer
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can innovative technology be used to preserve vegetables?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe how to make a homemade sun dryer for vegetables
2. construct a homemade sun dryer to preserve vegetables

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Homemade Sun Dryer

Teach
• Observe Homemade Sun Dryer in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Homemade Sun Dryer (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Homemade Sun Dryer.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Homemade Sun Dryer.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Homemade Sun Dryer.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• describe how to make a homemade sun dryer for vegetables
• construct a homemade sun dryer to preserve vegetables

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Homemade Sun Dryer.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Homemade Sun Dryer: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can innovative technology be used to preserve vegetables?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe how to make a homemade sun dryer for vegetables
• construct a homemade sun dryer to preserve vegetables

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
